Class Matrix3

java.lang.Object
net.murat.math.Matrix3
public class Matrix3 extends Object
Represents a 3x3 matrix for linear transformations in 3D space. FULLY GC-FRIENDLY - ZERO ALLOCATION in hot paths. All methods mutate 'this' or write to a target parameter. No "Local" suffix - all methods are already garbage-free.
